stream.name: ai_events_stream
stream.sql: CREATE STREAM ai_events_stream (event_id STRING, camera_id STRING, type STRING, confidence FLOAT, timestamp STRING, object_id STRING) WITH (DATASOURCE="cctv/ai/events/+/+", TYPE="mqtt", FORMAT="json", SHARED="true")

rules.description: 원본 이벤트 ID를 보존해 직접 수신 경로와 명령 ID가 달라지지 않게 한다.
rules.sql: SELECT event_id, camera_id, type, confidence, timestamp, object_id FROM ai_events_stream WHERE type IN ('danger_zone', 'person', 'helmet', 'fall_detected', 'unsafe_behavior') AND confidence >= {{INTRUSION_CONFIDENCE}}

SELECT camera_id, MAX(confidence) AS max_confidence, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, window_end() AS detected_until FROM ai_events_stream WHERE type IN ('danger_zone', 'person', 'helmet', 'fall_detected', 'unsafe_behavior') AND confidence >= {{INTRUSION_CONFIDENCE}} GROUP BY camera_id, TUMBLINGWINDOW(ss, 5) HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{PERSIST_HIT_COUNT}}

rules.description: 고신뢰 이벤트도 원본 ID를 보존해 규칙 경유 재수신을 같은 명령으로 식별한다.
rules.sql: SELECT event_id, camera_id, type, confidence, timestamp, object_id, 'critical' AS severity FROM ai_events_stream WHERE type IN ('danger_zone', 'fall_detected', 'unsafe_behavior') AND confidence >= {{CRITICAL_CONFIDENCE}}
